To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MAb R2.60 recognizes a novel lymphocyte determinant that is present on a functionally important protein on activated CTLs.

the R2.60 determinant is present on a functionally important, membrane-bound dimer on murine activated cytotoxic T cells, and that the same molecule is expressed on a subset of BM hematopoietic progenitor/stem cells.
a novel T cell marker has been isolated that is present on peripheral T cells, on activated CTLs, on a subset of BM stem cells, and on adult thymocyte progenitors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of novel markers of BM hematopoietic progenitor cells and the characterization of their function on peripheral T cells.

the identification and characterization of a novel T cell marker, R2/60, that may play a role in the activation and effector function of CTLs, and that is expressed on a subset of BM hematopoietic cells.
the characterization of a novel marker of murines T lymphocytes that may have a functional role in the effector phase of T cell-mediated cytotoxicity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the R2-60 antigen is a marker of murine hematopoietic progenitor cells that is also expressed on peripheral T lymphocytes, and is functionally important on activated CTLs.
the R2-60 antigen is involved in the transmembrane signaling of activated CTLs, although it does not appear to be involved in the inductive phase.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the R2-60 marker identifies a functionally important membrane component of CTLs.
MAb R2-60 defines a new marker of hematopoietic cells and that the R2-60 determinant is a functionally important membrane molecule of activated CTLs.

MAb R2-60 defines a lymphocyte surface molecule that is involved in transduction of the cytolytic signal to activated CTLs and which is expressed by a subset of BM stem cells, adult thymocytes and peripheral T cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the R2-60 determinant is a novel marker for BM HSCs that is expressed on activated CTLs, suggesting a possible role for these cells in the regulation of hematopoiesis.
MAb R2-60 defines a new T cell marker that is expressed on a subset of BM hematopoietic cells and on peripheral T cells.
the R2-60 determinant is expressed on a subset of BM stem cells, on activated T cells, and is involved in transduction signals to already activated T cells.
